svg.title: Sky surveys · Cosmic Library
svg.desc: Sky surveys (Explore): Pan the real sky in a dozen wavelengths. Animated card: The same patch of sky around Orion fades through six wavelengths, radio, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray and gamma ray, while a marker slides along the electromagnetic spectrum and a caption says what each band shows.
svg.text: Pan the real sky in a dozen wavelengths
